headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title_en: Fed's Goolsbee says he supports the July decision to hold rates steady
headlines.summary_en: Fed's Goolsbee said he supports the July decision to hold rates steady. He noted that recent productivity data in two periods were disappointing, and if productivity continues to decline, the Fed may need to reassess market expectations for artificial intelligence (AI). Goolsbee said the latest CPI data was encouraging, but more data is needed before making a judgment; persistent consumer weakness is concerning, though weak retail sales are so far only a one-month performance. Meanwhile, U.S. GDP and the labor market remain broadly stable overall.

headlines.title: 沃伦致函 要求贝森特说明干预日元的依据
headlines.summary: 美国参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦要求财政部长斯科特·贝森特解释特朗普政府干预日元的依据，延续了这位资深民主党人对特朗普政府外汇政策进行审查的一贯做法。沃伦在一封日期为8月13日的信中写道，“迄今为止，政府仍未就此次干预提供详细依据，也没有正式披露动用了多少与纳税人相关的资金来购买日元。”在7月31日采取相关行动后，贝森特证实了媒体有关美日自1998年以来首次联合干预汇市以支撑日元的报道，但尚未说明动用了多少资金。（彭博）

headlines.title_en: Warren writes to Bessent demanding the rationale for yen intervention
headlines.summary_en: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren has demanded that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent explain the rationale behind the Trump administration's intervention in the yen, continuing the senior Democrat's pattern of scrutinizing the Trump administration's foreign exchange policy. In a letter dated August 13, Warren wrote, 'To date, the administration has not provided a detailed rationale for this intervention, nor has it formally disclosed how much taxpayer-related funding was used to purchase yen.' After taking related action on July 31, Bessent confirmed media reports that the U.S. and Japan conducted their first joint currency intervention since 1998 to support the yen, but has not yet specified how much funding was used. (Bloomberg)

headlines.summary: 今天（8月14日），上海市委书记陈吉宁用一整天时间在中国（上海）自由贸易试验区临港新片区调研并主持召开座谈会。陈吉宁指出，临港新片区要始终把先进制造业摆在突出位置，坚定不移提升能级和核心竞争力。抢抓数智化绿色化机遇，在抓好项目落地同时更加注重培育产业生态，注重培育龙头企业和高成长企业，注重布局产业平台、提升服务能力，增强产业发展的韧性和黏性，推动集成电路、民用航空、智能汽车、高端装备等主导产业积厚成势。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: push leading industries like integrated circuits, civil aviation, smart vehicles, and high-end equipment to solidify and scale up
headlines.summary_en: Today (August 14), Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining spent a full day researching and chairing a symposium in the Lin-gang Special Area of the China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone. Chen Jining noted that Lin-gang should always prioritize advanced manufacturing and unwaveringly enhance its capabilities and core competitiveness. Seizing opportunities in digitalization and greening, it should focus not only on project implementation but also on cultivating the industrial ecosystem, nurturing leading enterprises and high-growth companies, and laying out industrial platforms to improve service capabilities, enhancing the resilience and stickiness of industrial development, and driving leading industries such as integrated circuits, civil aviation, smart vehicles, and high-end equipment to build strength.

headlines.title: 中创新航预计上半年净利润至少翻倍：得益于新客户、新应用场景拓展
headlines.summary: 中创新航发布2026年中期业绩预告。公告显示，上半年公司预计实现净利润约人民币15.06亿元至15.81亿元，较去年同期（同比）上升约100%至110%。去年同期，中创新航净利润约为人民币7.53亿元。公告称，公司利润同比上升，主要得益于新客户、新应用场景拓展，以及新产品在乘用、商用、储能等领域持续上量，业务规模持续增长。

headlines.title_en: Calb Group expects H1 net profit at least to double, driven by expansion into new customers and application scenarios
headlines.summary_en: CALB released its 2026 interim results forecast. The announcement shows that the company expects to achieve net profit of approximately RMB 1.506 billion to RMB 1.581 billion in the first half, up about 100% to 110% from the same period last year. In the same period last year, CALB's net profit was approximately RMB 753 million. The announcement stated that the rise in profit was mainly due to expansion into new customers and application scenarios, as well as continued volume growth of new products in passenger, commercial, and energy storage fields, with business scale continuing to grow.

headlines.title_en: Zhiyang Innovation: Plans Private Placement to Raise Up to 904 Million Yuan for Embodied Intelligence and Other Projects
headlines.summary_en: Zhiyang Innovation announced that its 2026 private placement plan for A-shares has been approved by the board of directors. The issuance targets no more than 35 specific investors, with the issue price no lower than 80% of the average trading price of the company's shares over the 20 trading days prior to the pricing benchmark date. The number of shares issued will not exceed 98.4008 million shares (inclusive), i.e., no more than 30% of the total share capital before issuance.
